snippet.title: Super Cabbage Kabumi - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Super Cabbage Kabumi is an upcoming roguelike game about bonking cabbages with a ball.  Create incredible builds by synergizing a huge variety of items, unlock powerful pets, and try to beat the game with all of the Chaos Cabbages which completely change the way you play!

Release Date: November 2025

Wishlist Super Cabbage Kabumi on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734140/Super_Cabbage_Kabumi/
